explanation: Re-reviewed for the public repository, compared with the private source main branch. Four tracked files differ only by the export: the OXT reference README says the compressed inputs are not public and points to the reproduced Goff Lab MIT LICENSE; the pipeline-separation review README names a generic python instead of a local interpreter path; run_atlas_r460.R defaults ATLAS_INPUT_DIR and ATLAS_OUT_ROOT to relative atlas-input and regen-r460/macaque instead of the maintainer's drive paths (both remain overridable and no statistical code changes); and run_all.sh no longer calls the withheld build_scorecard.R. About 100 retained evidence files of this area (measure.py, continuation and HFD-intake reports and their producers) are not tracked here; part is restored by fetch:data. The September 11 intake review this record cited is one of them, so it is no longer referenced.
